strict_chain_disagreement: blocks fitted C admission; never alters the historical strict oracle
estimation: maximum a posteriori; empirical-Bayes unseen-item random-effects integration conditional on training hierarchy coefficients

quadrature.method: Gauss-Legendre on normal quantiles; truncated-normal log-discrimination

outer_group_assignment: integer SHA-256(group_id) modulo 5, preserved from version 1
full_schedule_outcomes: excluded from every fit and inner selection; used only by final forecast evaluation
inner_target: last earlier rung (75 percent); fit on lower rungs
M1: weighted pool-adjacent-violators with interpolation through all block endpoints, trained on earlier adjacent transitions
candidate_selection: minimum pooled inner held-out log loss, exact ties M3

bootstrap.unit: task group, paired across models/policies; fixed fitted predictions

calibration.criterion: paired group-bootstrap 95% interval for mean prediction-minus-outcome bias contains zero
calibration.criterion_source: prospective operationalization of PROTOCOL section 4 calibration requirement; not evidence that calibration is exact

synthetic_recovery.pattern: actual risk counts and missingness, after R2
synthetic_recovery.threshold_source: prospective implementation controls, declared before historical validation factors

anchors.current_ability_prior: N(0,1), earlier train rollouts only, fixed items
anchors.weights: a*(1-q), normalized across d/t/p, frozen throughout group

post_L1_policy: no score-driven configuration changes or gate retries

feature_extraction.python_tokens: stdlib tokenize; excludes comments, indentation and newline tokens
feature_extraction.industry_domain: one-hot vocabulary fitted on training-fold tasks; unseen domain all-zero
